note: CardMachine is the copy model of 02_card_move.lua (a primary also sits at null or done, and a copy has a leg) and SprintEvents is the event-driven tick. lifecycle.go runs six states, waiting ready working review merging landed, and names tla/SprintTables.tla, which is not in this tree. Neither module is the machine the tick runs.

CardISA holds the instruction set of docs/SPEC-ISA.md: one Wait over an operand, and a result per kind, with three reversed witnesses. lifecycle.go still releases a sentinel on its own move, so the running waits are not that one action. The stale note on the sprint models does not cover this module; the running lifecycle is still the six states.

A card's attempts, the generation a move writes, and the epoch a clear advances are in the store. Land models the epoch only as the lander reads it, and EpochMemberTable is the table layer's epoch, not the sprint's. No module holds this machine.

DirtyTickRead holds one read per card and does not redeal. The code counts a re-ask when the reader hands the read back, draws a read from the tier's index, and keeps a begun read on a reader that went away (tla/README.md).

Land holds the batch, the check of the caller's epoch before any git, the report fenced to the epoch land read, a refusal of the card's own head reworking it (or reviewing it at its bound) with the stream going on and the lander's own failure stopping it (2026-10-06), and seven reversed witnesses. land.go still does that check. Catalog rows and generated ledgers regenerated inside a batch, and the ancestry check named by land-verify-landed-ancestry, are not in the module. LandPass holds the pass over several streams (2026-10-07): the merges in parallel up to a width, the landings one at a time in priority order, a pushed tip that passed its own gate, the combined gate, or a clean merge of disjoint files, a landing never lost by the merge after, a collision refusal that stops no stream, a tip recorded as gated only when a gate saw its whole tree (the next pass gates a disjoint merge), a re-merge that merges fewer heads or none, with six reversed witnesses and the liveness that with every tree green every batch lands; landpass.go runs those two phases. Since 2026-10-10 the landings go as each batch is built (NoHeadOfLine, the inorder witness), each stream's deadline on its own clock from its slot, and LandBisect holds a red batch's blame by bisection (at most ceil(log2 n) gates, a bench fault blaming no head), with three reversed witnesses.

SeatHealth holds the seat generation and a friend's health: a proof dated after the server clock is refused, and six reversed witnesses. seat.go and friend_health.go have not changed since the module.

Friend holds the connection (a ping inside the window, an outage said once) and the session challenge. The daemon's delivery of a note, handed or deferred or given up after its bound, is not in the module.

FriendStage holds the daemon's staging of the jobs it writes: a stage begun only for a written brief, a lane handed a card only once its JOB.md is there, one judgment per unreachable repository or missing base while it stands, a stop that says nothing, and a failed job staged again once its remedy lands, with three reversed witnesses. The mirror's freshness window, the per-repository lock and the checkout's move-in are below the module's grain; a read's checkout is not staged and is not in it.

FriendReadyTake holds a friend's own take of a ready card on her row (her row only, while she is up, within her lanes), the batch deal's fill of a free lane from her ready cards, her finish's next, and the judgment of a card ready in front of a free lane at FriendReadyMax, with four reversed witnesses. FriendRedealLate holds the take-back of a card she has not started (rule friend-take) and the redeal to the next friend: measured from her own deal, the judgment raised while the card sat withdrawn closed on it, one reversed witness. A friend's one-shot lanes have no module.

Bus2 holds a send to every recipient and the log in one step, pending until ack, and a live reader keeping its message until ClaimAfter, with five reversed witnesses. bus.go cites those properties. A message kind and RecvKinds, which releases a skipped kind at once and which the code maps to a lost holder, are not states in the module. The module header still names internal/bus2/bus2.go, which this tree does not have; the machine is internal/bus.
A member's presence on the fleet table, and the swarm's lease on a slot, have no module.
The merge queue, a card's promotion into it, and the member's tree have no module. Land models only the batch pushed from the queue. The two-level landing module CardISA cites is not in this tree.
A held card or member, a sentinel, and a stopped stream have no module of their own. CardISA folds those waits into one Wait and is not this machine.

SprintRules holds twins, the attempt bounds, the read-broken rule (rework or twin wider, left at the brief's bound), the harness-fault rework and the late report that finishes a failed attempt (Part answers), the late rule, the base gate and the idle alarm, in the same commit as the late-rule code. The judgments the tick raises, and the answers to them, are in decide.go and are not in the module.

Level holds the machine rebalance at the start of a tick: levelTo, a gap of at least two, both end guards, and five reversed witnesses. steps_work.go cites the module. Friend level in internal/sprint/friend_level.go, within a class, and the readers' level are outside the module, which says the readers' level is not modelled. No card named for this map owes friend level, so it is named here rather than as a row with an empty owed_by.

RouteIndex holds the counter, a redeal and a pinned card, and checks a read with one draw and no redeal. The code also draws a read from the reader tier's index beside work cards (tla/README.md), and a route whose first flag is set deals before the others.

ServerLanes holds the one line of control and the beat and read lanes, with three reversed witnesses. servelanes.go still cites GoneNeverRuns. A later edit only lets a friend beat carry the flags of its report; the lane machine is unchanged.
check.go computes violations from a snapshot, so a break is found. Nothing in this tree stores a violation as found, then answered, then cleared, and no module holds that lifecycle.
No module, and no Go file in this tree, is an install that rolls back when ticks are missed. seat install in cmd/nova-sprint/seatinstall.go is a different verb and is not this machine.

UpdateApply holds one run of the version inventory, the state file, and a delivery recorded only after the bus says SEND OK, with three reversed witnesses. The code delivers by nova-bus send. The older join path is gone; the module already names the bus only as that SEND OK.

CairnStore holds the session, the append, the log, and a gap when a crash falls between the entry and the log, with three reversed witnesses. cairn.go still writes an entry atomically, does not report before that write, and heals an interrupted open by logging the open record.

The table layer is the modelled layer (tla/README.md): contracts, member and epoch placement, edits, order, the shell, the function libraries, first contact and the fuse box. Each module has an expected-fail witness. TableMachine and RedisFn name that witness without the word Broken in the configuration file; the plan's expected column is not pass.

CardContract holds the finish of a card, the member's push and the one judgment, with eleven reversed witnesses. A finish or push file that is not a regular file is no record, the same absent record the module already finishes from, not a new state.

WorkImport holds an issue under import and a repository's sync, with five reversed witnesses. Later refusals, an org-wide dry run, an existing output directory, and a verify of two trees, are command guards and not new states of that machine.

BenchRun holds one nova-ci bench run: the hosts in order, the make, copy, exec and remove steps on the first host that answers, and an interrupt that may land at any step, with one reversed witness (a failed copy that skips the deferred remove). Every host's answer and every step's outcome is chosen by TLC, so the model covers each order of failure the code can meet.

BenchStage holds one bench's stage: the seed, the send measured from bytes, verification of the whole set before the first rename, a binary skipped when it already holds the release bytes, and a crash anywhere, with one reversed witness. The later stage-then-rename in install.go is that verify-before-rename.

ConfigApply holds a store write and its history row, the per-kind revision, Redis as a copy, the stamp after the ops, and machine before friend, with four reversed witnesses. It was written from this code. Friend slots, tiers and the bench registry set are outside the instance, which says field checks beyond the ref are.
A secret's placement, its sealing, and the seat's key have no module.
A decision's record, and the decision of one attempt, have no module.

DirtyTick holds the tick as shaped on 2026-09-30. The code deals up to twice a member's width and rebalances the fleet table and the readers table at the start of every tick, and the model has no such step (tla/README.md).
FileLock holds the lock file's take and a stale holder, with four reversed witnesses. filelock.go cites the module. The only change since the module is the wording of the package comment.

CoordinatorWake holds the cursor written before the wake line, and a cursor that does not skip an event, with two reversed witnesses, in the same commit as watchwake.go. One cursor stands for the per-kind cursors, as the module says. The code has not changed since.

Bus2Receipts (EXTENDS Bus2) holds the receipt states (delivered, read, acted) over the delivery machine, moved only by the Forward rule, and the daemon's idempotent take, turn, ack, a lost ack and a crash, with ReceiptNeverMovesBack, ActedImpliesDelivered and NoIdActedTwice and two reversed witnesses (a take that pushes a redelivered id, a recv that writes delivered over the receipt). The model reads the receipt at the take; the code reads it at the recv (Entry.Stage). A refused acted stamp is not modelled.

Delivery holds the full available pending set, the adapter text cap, accepted-envelope acknowledgments, claim reopening and eventual delivery. EnvelopeTakesAll and NoYoungerFirst hold with the two reversed witnesses; the failure-reorder witness documents that a held failed message can be acknowledged after a younger one. Metadata, authority labels and proof-id lifetime are below this model grain.

Caller-owned byte cursor over complete append-only records; bus return and process restart retain unread records; file replacement and truncation refuse. Broken EOF rearm skips an undelivered record. Prefix hash validation is the byte-level implementation fence, not an LLM receipt.
